verdict.rationale: Conductor is a Mac desktop app that runs multiple coding agents in parallel. Each task gets its own workspace with a terminal and diff, and the docs say Conductor helps you review the diff before opening a PR. Community users welcome having a UI for parallel worktree sessions. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the visual diff viewer (layout, line-level review/comments), explicit evidence that sessions can be viewed simultaneously side by side rather than switched between, and independent hands-on corroboration of the diff review experience.
